atmos: TaiAM1 (0.9x1.25 degree; 288 x 192 longitude/latitude; 30 levels; top level ~2 hPa)

land: CLM4.0 (same grid as atmos)
landIce: none
ocean: POP2 (320x384 longitude/latitude; 60 levels; top grid cell 0-10 m)
ocnBgchem: none
seaIce: CICE4
institution: Research Center for Environmental Changes, Academia Sinica, Nankang, Taipei 11529, Taiwan
experiment: all-forcing simulation of the recent past
grid: finite-volume grid with 0.9x1.25 degree lat/lon resolution
title: TaiESM1 output prepared for CMIP6

aridity_index.description: Calculated from precipitation and potential evapotranspiration.
aridity_index.comment: Aridity index is the ratio of precipitation to potential evapotranspiration. It is a measure of the degree of dryness of the climate at a given location. A value of 1 indicates that precipitation is equal to potential evapotranspiration, values greater than 1 indicate that precipitation is greater than potential evapotranspiration, and values less than 1 indicate that precipitation is less than potential evapotranspiration.
